source_annotation.prompt: Pick up the clamp from the table and place it in the container.

generation_prompt: The robot uses the hand entering from the lower-right edge to close its thumb and fingers around the blue clamp on the red tabletop and lift it. It carries the clamp left over the rim of the white wire basket, lowers it inside, and opens its hand to release it onto the basket floor. The hand then withdraws, leaving the clamp resting in the basket. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
